parameters.query:
SELECT public.get_user_context_last_session(
  '{{ $('User Exist').item.json.get_user_by_channel.user_id }}',
  -1  -- history_limit negativo => attiva modalità "ultima sessione"
)

WITH
-- 1. Fetch & lock the verification row (if valid and unexpired)
verification AS (
    SELECT id, user_id, channel_id
    FROM public.channel_verifications
    WHERE nonce = '{{ $json.nonce }}'
      AND expires_at > now()
    FOR UPDATE
),
-- 2. Detect if the desired link is already owned by another user on the same channel
conflict_check AS (
    SELECT 1 AS link_taken
    FROM public.user_channels uc
    JOIN verification v ON uc.channel_id = v.channel_id
    WHERE uc.link = '{{ $('Normalize').item.json.id }}'
      AND uc.user_id <> v.user_id
    LIMIT 1
),
-- 3. Perform the upsert only if: verification row exists AND no conflicting ownership
upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO public.user_channels (user_id, channel_id, link, verified_at)
    SELECT v.user_id, v.channel_id, '{{ $('Normalize').item.json.id }}', now()
    FROM verification v
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conflict_check)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, channel_id) DO UPDATE
       SET link        = EXCLUDED.link,
           verified_at = now(),
           updated_at  = now()
    RETURNING id AS user_channel_id, user_id
),
-- 4. Consume (delete) the verification row only if we actually used it (i.e. no conflict)
cleanup AS (
    DELETE FROM public.channel_verifications cv
    USING verification v
    WHERE cv.id = v.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conflict_check)
    RETURNING 1
)
-- 5. Build the unified JSONB result
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification)
            THEN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Invalid or expired verification code.')
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conflict_check)
            THEN jsonb_build_object('error', 'This channel account is already linked to another user.')
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upsert)
            THEN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Failed to link channel (unexpected).')
        ELSE jsonb_build_object(
                 'user_id',        (SELECT user_id FROM upsert),
                 'user_channel_id',(SELECT user_channel_id FROM upsert)
             )
    END AS result;

parameters.query:
WITH user_info AS (
  SELECT id AS user_id, stripe_customer_id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE id = '{{ $('User').item.json.get_user_by_channel.user_id }}'
)

, customer AS (
  SELECT 'customer' AS entity, to_jsonb(c) AS data
  FROM stripe.customers c
  JOIN user_info u ON c.id = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, subscriptions AS (
  SELECT 'subscription' AS entity, to_jsonb(s) AS data
  FROM stripe.subscriptions s
  JOIN user_info u ON s.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, subscription_items AS (
  SELECT 'subscription_item' AS entity, to_jsonb(si) AS data
  FROM stripe.subscription_items si
  JOIN stripe.subscriptions s ON si.subscription = s.id
  JOIN user_info u ON s.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, invoices AS (
  SELECT 'invoice' AS entity, to_jsonb(i) AS data
  FROM stripe.invoices i
  JOIN user_info u ON i.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, payment_intents AS (
  SELECT 'payment_intent' AS entity, to_jsonb(pi) AS data
  FROM stripe.payment_intents pi
  JOIN user_info u ON pi.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, payment_methods AS (
  SELECT 'payment_method' AS entity, to_jsonb(pm) AS data
  FROM stripe.payment_methods pm
  JOIN user_info u ON pm.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, charges AS (
  SELECT 'charge' AS entity, to_jsonb(ch) AS data
  FROM stripe.charges ch
  JOIN user_info u ON ch.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
)

, refunds AS (
  SELECT 'refund' AS entity, to_jsonb(r) AS data
  FROM stripe.refunds r
  JOIN user_info u ON r.charge IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM stripe.charges ch WHERE ch.id = r.charge AND ch.customer = u.stripe_customer_id
  )
)

SELECT
  entity,
  (data - 'id') || jsonb_build_object('id', data ->> 'id') AS data
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM customer
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM subscriptions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM subscription_items
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM invoices
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM payment_intents
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM payment_methods
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM charges
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM refunds
) AS t;
